==Usage==
This template is used to create multi-row cells for trade paperbacks and other collections in comic tables. It should be included within {{Para|tpb}} parameter of {{Tl|Comictable-arc}} or {{Tl|Comictable-issue}}.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Comictable-tpb|''image''|''name''|''release date''|rowspan=}}
